description: This Java class 'ContentServices' provides a set of static methods for managing content and content associations within the Apache OFBiz content management system. It includes functionalities such as finding related content, traversing content trees, activating/deactivating content associations, rendering subcontent as text, and utility methods for string manipulation and URL encoding.

classes.name: ContentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for content management operations within OFBiz, including content retrieval, association management, rendering, and utility functions.

methods.name: findRelatedContent
methods.description: Retrieves content related to the current content based on association types, operation lists, and content types. Performs permission checks if target operations are specified.

methods.name: findContentParents
methods.description: Traverses the content tree to find parent contents of a specified content, building a list of parent content IDs.

methods.name: traverseContent
methods.description: Traverses a content tree starting from a specified content ID, returning the node map and pick list, with options for date filtering.

methods.name: deactivateContentAssoc
methods.description: Deactivates a specific content association by updating its 'thruDate' to the current timestamp, with permission checks.

methods.name: deactivateContentAssocMethod
methods.description: Performs the actual update operation to deactivate a content association, with permission verification.

methods.name: deactivateAssocs
methods.description: Deactivates other active content associations related to a specific template/content ID, excluding the current one.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsText
methods.description: Retrieves and renders subcontent as plain text, writing output to the provided writer.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Retrieves and renders content as plain text, with support for additional view data.

methods.name: linkContentToPubPt
methods.description: Links content to a publication point, setting status and permissions accordingly, including creation or deactivation of associations.

methods.name: publishContent
methods.description: Marks a content entity as published by updating its status ID.

methods.name: getPrefixedMembers
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from a map where keys start with a specified prefix.

methods.name: splitString
methods.description: Splits an input string into a list based on the specified delimiter.

methods.name: joinString
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string separated by the specified delimiter.

methods.name: urlEncodeArgs
methods.description: URL-encodes a map of argument key-value pairs into a query string.
